sentences.en: We didn't start with much money or many endorsements.
sentences.zh: 我们一开始并没有很多资金，也没有多少背书。

sentences.en: Actors and sports stars often parlay their celebrity into endorsement deals.
sentences.zh: 演员和体育明星常常利用自己的名气来获得代言合同。

sentences.en: I'm really glad Mei gave me her endorsement.
sentences.zh: 梅给我背书我真的很高兴。

senses.zh: 背书,批注;违章记录 赞同,支持
